rows.title: Core, diamond & rotary rigs
rows.text: We design and manufacture core, diamond, and rotary drilling machines built for precision and durability. Each unit is developed to perform efficiently in various geological conditions, for exploration and mining operations.
rows.imageAlt: A yellow core drilling rig in the Indorig workshop

rows.title: Fast availability, less downtime
rows.text: Our extensive inventory ensures fast availability and replacement, reducing downtime and maintaining operational efficiency. We also manufacture and modify gearboxes to improve power transmission and fit various rig configurations.

rows.title: Peak performance, every machine
rows.text: Our dedicated technical team offers maintenance, calibration, and repair services, ensuring every machine operates at peak performance. We prioritize customer satisfaction through responsive support and expert care.

rows.title: Custom-built for your terrain
rows.text: Every project has unique challenges. We offer custom-built machines and tailored modifications to meet specific depth, material, or terrain requirements, working closely with clients from design to delivery.
rows.imageAlt: Custom built rig on a transport truck

parts.text: Gears, shafts, and gearboxes are made and modified in-house to fit your rig configuration.
